findings.text: follow-on: _carry_fence_unprotected recomposes fence_unprotected_paths from the attempt's own fence, but the sibling field fenced is written only by primary dispatch (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5540), so a cli run lane-changed to an in-harness backend keeps fenced:true on its pointer and committed ledger row beside an absent removed-list. The staleness is pre-existing (neither resume_plan nor change_lane ever set fenced) and the landed change does not introduce it, but the two fields now describe different attempts within one record.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against f249ccb5; a25d996c adds 25 lines to reckon/crew/dispatch.py (the _carry_fence_unprotected helper plus fence_config=config and its three call sites), 9 to reckon/crew/promotion.py, and the 413-line new test file, and 2b435cb adds only the evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_unprotected_paths_reach_every_launch.py's three cases and the declared negative control; the manifest records the node gate 3 passed and the base and head importer arms.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that a removed protected default is honoured and recorded on the resume and lane-change launch paths and on the committed ledger row; at head 2b435cb resume_plan (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:8785) and change_lane (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:9174) now pass fence_config=config and _carry_fence_unprotected (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:8662) records the removed list on the pointer, with promotion (reckon/crew/promotion.py:6564) copying it onto the row.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits a25d996c and 2b435cb over base f249ccb5, node gate 3 passed, and the base and head importer arms each 14 failed / 1309 passed / 1 error with identical failing ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths; every path in the diff (reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_unprotected_paths_reach_every_launch.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-worker-cannot-write-your-home/unprotected-paths-reach-every-launch.html) is inside them.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log drops the fence_config argument from the resume path and tests/test_unprotected_paths_reach_every_launch.py::test_case_1_a_resumed_run_leaves_the_default_writable fails on the sealed-default assertion at tests/test_unprotected_paths_reach_every_launch.py:266.
justifications.evidence: the node gate tests/test_unprotected_paths_reach_every_launch.py is recorded 3 passed in node-gate.log at revision a25d996c, and negative-control.log applies the declared mutation and shows case 1 reddening with EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: the helper mirrors the primary-dispatch condition at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5547 and follows the surrounding pointer-mutation idiom; the new names carry no plan, ticket or version identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:8785 and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:9174 pass fence_config=config into the same plan builder primary dispatch calls at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5515, and _carry_fence_unprotected at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:8662 records the removed list exactly as the primary path does at :5543.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the two commits' diff (reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_unprotected_paths_reach_every_launch.py, the evidence fragment) is inside the manifest's declared write paths.
